items.rationale: Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude the pane because optional glazing cover is not shown as agreed. The conditional gross estimate is €130 for one like-for-like pane.

items.description: Hole drilling for the replacement pane
items.rationale: Drilling to receive the pane or its hardware is preparatory glazing work under sections 1.3 and 3.5(b), so it follows the excluded pane. The conditional gross estimate is €20 for one drilling operation.
Section 3.5(b) excludes fitting the replacement glass even when separately itemised. The conditional gross estimate is €75 for fitting one pane, without a separate attendance charge.
Sections 3.5(b) and 5.2.1 exclude disposal of the uninsured pane; billing it as debris removal does not restore cover. The conditional gross estimate is €24 for disposal during the fitting visit.

items.description: Repair of dented solid-wood side table
items.rationale: The impact is sudden accidental damage to insured contents under sections 2.6.1 and 4.2.6. Under sections 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.5, €270 gross allows for local dent repair and finish restoration, not refinishing the whole table; no deductible amount is stated.

items.description: Touch-up of old scratches on second cabinet
items.rationale: Sections 3.6(a) and 7.1.9 exclude scratches that pre-date the incident, even when treated alongside covered work. The conditional gross estimate is €105 for one local touch-up.

items.description: Contractor vehicle charge for first visit
items.rationale: Section 7.1.12 allows one attendance in full when covered work was carried out, without apportioning it for the old-scratch touch-up. The estimate is €30 gross for one ordinary local vehicle charge.

items.description: Contractor vehicle charge for return visit
items.rationale: Section 7.1.12 excludes a return visit by the same contractor unless the insurer agreed in advance, which is not shown. If approval were established, the estimate would be €30 gross for the additional visit.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administrative overhead. The conditional gross estimate is €20 for one flat charge.
